subject: Re: SIG follow-up — live recovery replay & artifact package
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@bluevault.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueVault SIG <sig-requests@bluevault.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — request for live recovery replay and logs

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the SOC2/SIG onboarding yesterday. The SIG review team has a couple of follow-ups specific to BCP/DR that would benefit from a short live demonstration plus a set of artifacts we can attach to the questionnaire:

- A timeboxed "recovery replay" demonstrating restore -> KV cache replay -> application warm-start across two AZs (we don't need production traffic, simulated traffic is fine).
- Timestamped restore logs (S3 restore events, orchestration events) spanning the restore start through the service being reachable.
- A KV cache replay trace showing prefix load durations and observed token-level warmup times (per-shard if possible).
- Evidence of RTO/RPO measurement methodology for Dedicated and Private modes (how you measure, what the clocks/timestamps are, any known variance).

Ideal ask: 60-90 minute live session where you run the replay and we observe, plus a post-demo artifact bundle (logs + a short writeup). Can you confirm availability next week (UTC windows preferred) and a point of contact to: (1) schedule the demo, (2) run the replay, and (3) assemble the artifact bundle?

Also note: SIG will want artifact file names that align with their cataloging (e.g., "bluevault_playback_YYYYMMDD.log"). If you can attach a proposed runbook or checklist in your reply that would help us plan.

Best,
Anna
Anna Li
Security Assessments — BlueVault Financial
anna.li@bluevault.com

--
Attachment(s): none listed

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — request for live recovery replay and logs

Thanks Anna — we can run this. Adding Ben (ops lead) and Dev (infrastructure) to coordinate the technical run, and Kim for the artifacts/packaging.

High-level plan:
- Prep: confirm scope (Dedicated vs Private vs both), environment (staging or isolated cluster), and size (single-model vs multi-model).
- Replay session: 60 minutes total; 30 minutes for restore + KV replay, 20 minutes warm-up & validation, 10 minutes Q&A.
- Artifacts: timestamped restore log (S3 events), orchestration event trace, KV replay trace, short writeup of RTO/RPO measurement methodology.

We attached a proposed playback runbook and a KV replay checklist to this message for your review. If the SIG prefers a different filename convention we can produce a second set named per their catalog.

Proposed demo windows (UTC):
- Tue 2026-08-11 14:00–15:30 UTC
- Wed 2026-08-12 09:00–10:30 UTC

Please confirm a preferred window and which deployment mode you'd like demonstrated.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — request for live recovery replay and logs

Looping in technical details from infra side (quick notes so scheduling has the right expectations):

- Environment: we recommend using a Dedicated replica in our staging region (us-west-2) to mirror production topology. Private (VPC) replay is possible but requires BlueVault to provide target VPC peering or a temporary access window; that will add ~48 hours of setup.
- Steps and rough durations:
  1) Trigger snapshot restore (S3) — 8–12 minutes depending on object sizes.
  2) Start orchestration -> node boot and model load — 6–10 minutes.
  3) KV cache replay (prefix load across shards) — 5–15 minutes depending on prefix volume. We'll stream a KV replay trace that includes per-shard timing and per-batch token warmup times.
  4) Health checks & synthetic traffic validation — 3–5 minutes.
- Artifacts we will attach:
  - bluevault_playback_YYYYMMDD_restore_events.log (S3 event listing, timestamps)
  - bluevault_playback_YYYYMMDD_orch_trace.jsonl (orchestration events)
  - bluevault_playback_YYYYMMDD_kv_replay.trace (replay-marker-trace.log)
  - rto_rpo_methodology.md (short writeup with measurement clocks and definitions)

Note: for SIG/CAIQ the orchestration trace is useful but we will also redact any ephemeral IPs / node names before sharing. We'll produce both a full trace for BlueVault security and a sanitized version for the SIG artifact bundle.

I attached a short marker trace we used in a previous tabletop; it shows how we stamp replay segments and correlate to orchestration events.

-Dev
Dev Patel
Lead Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachment(s): replay-marker-trace.log

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick turnaround. BlueVault confirmed the Dedicated replay is fine for SIG; no Private/VPC demo required for this pass. We've scheduled the live session for: 

  Wednesday, 12 Aug 2026 — 09:00–10:30 UTC (Redwood staging, us-west-2)

Session plan (final):
- 09:00–09:15 — brief intro & scope (Priya / Ben)
- 09:15–09:35 — trigger restore and monitor S3 restore events (Dev)
- 09:35–09:50 — orchestration events & node/model load (Dev)
- 09:50–10:05 — KV replay, per-shard timing, and synthetic validation (Dev)
- 10:05–10:25 — Q&A and artifact collection (Anna + SIG)
- 10:25–10:30 — next steps and file naming confirmation (Priya)

Artifacts we'll deliver within 24 hours after the session:
- bluevault_playback_20260812_restore_events.log
- bluevault_playback_20260812_orch_trace.jsonl (full and sanitized)
- bluevault_playback_20260812_kv_replay.trace
- rto_rpo_methodology.md
- redwood_rpo_rto_statement.txt (short statement of observed RTO/RPO in the run)

Attached is the playback plan (v1) for your review. If SIG wants additional metrics (cpu/GPU utilization, kernel selection logs, or token-level latency histograms) please flag them now so we can add collection points.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Priya
